INBOX.subject: RE: Palo Verde website - status update
INBOX.body:
Hi Michael,

While we were tracking down what you'd seen on the older URL, we took the
opportunity to do a fuller pass over the new build. A few things we found
and fixed on the spot without needing to wait on you, and a longer list
where we'd like your input before we go further.

FIXED ALREADY - NO ACTION NEEDED

- An unedited placeholder blog post ("Blog Post Title," leftover theme
boilerplate) was publicly visible - unpublished it.

- Leftover "Presenters / Attendees / Places" counters on the homepage - a
leftover from the theme's original event-site demo content, unrelated to a
cancer center - removed.

- All 5 insurance logos (UnitedHealthcare, Aetna, Cigna, Medicare, Humana)
were pulling from Wikimedia Commons links that Wikimedia had since moved -
they were showing as broken images on all 4 location pages. Re-sourced the
correct current logos and hosted them directly on the site so this can't
break again.

- Estrella was the only one of the 4 locations missing its "Find Us Here"
map - added it, matching the other 3 pages.

Staging build for reference: https://875051.us16.myftpupload.com/

NEEDS YOUR INPUT BEFORE WE GO FURTHER

1. pvcancer.com still isn't pointed at the new build. This is the root
cause of the mix-up last week, and it's the actual blocker to the site
being live to the public at all, regardless of how ready the content is.
Worth prioritizing.

2. The public intake forms collect SSN, date of birth, medical power of
attorney, and full insurance details. This is a compliance question more
than a content one - how is this data currently handled/encrypted, and is
a plain web form the right way to collect SSN at all? Wanted to raise it
directly rather than quietly change anything ourselves.

3. Contact email is inconsistent across the site. Most pages show
info@pvhomed.com, but Dr. Mamani's bio page shows
info@paloverdecancer.com. Which one is actually monitored? A lead could
currently go to the wrong inbox
